content.outro: The arch stands open behind you, and the toll yard is a way through again.
content.premise: The toll yard at Ashford Cut has been shut since the floods. Every way out of it is closed in its own fashion: the arch to the inner court is barred where everyone can see it, the toll house door is bolted from its own side, the keeper's hatch on the ledge is locked, and the old cart road behind the yard's fireplace has not been walked in years. The keeper left a key in the chest at the end of the passage. Somebody has to fetch it, open the cart road, and raise the bars on the arch from the toll house.
content.theme: A walled toll yard under a timber roof, every way out of it shut a different way, and the one honest way round.
content.title: Three Ways Shut
